status_policy: DONE means the exact task acceptance has evidence of the required kind; specification, implementation, component measurements and tests do not establish dependent installed/platform/release qualification. OPEN includes active or implemented work with remaining acceptance. BLOCKED identifies a required dependency, artifact, review or selected implementation that is unavailable. DEFERRED is permitted for a conditional migration when scoped measurements and the original PRD decision rule justify retaining the current implementation; an unbuilt native pilot is not an automatic prerequisite for that decision. Unmeasured large workloads, predicted gains without sufficient evidence, and active comparisons remain OPEN or BLOCKED. No native activation is implied by a completed selection/profiling task. Original id, number, title, acceptance and dependency fields remain unchanged. A DONE task does not satisfy its outstanding dependencies; those are reported separately in dependency_audit.
